reading: The sketch recreates a design-tool (Figma-like) screen: a dark top toolbar with breadcrumb text and a Share button, a left Layers/Assets panel with a list of rows, a main canvas showing a mobile onboarding screen mockup (hero image, title, body copy, a "Get started" button with a blue selection outline and size badge, a percent-zoom chip, a small purple "K" avatar), and a right-hand Inspector panel with Frame/Auto layout/Fill/Stroke/Effects/Export sections, all per the user's typed notes.
